ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, there are shorelines above and below the river channel. On the left side it is marked “direction of water flow,” with the arrow pointing to the right. Point O is in the middle slightly to the left, point A is to the right of O, and O to A is a horizontal dashed line segment, parallel to the direction of the water flow; point B is below O, and O to B is a vertical dashed line segment, perpendicular to the direction of the water flow. The problem gives OA=OB. Then reason: Let OA=OB=L, the water flow speed be u, and the two people have the same swimming speed in still water, set as v. Jia goes back and forth along OA: from O to A downstream, the speed relative to the bank is v+u, taking time L/(v+u); returning from A to O upstream, the speed relative to the bank is v-u, taking time L/(v-u). Therefore t甲=L/(v+u)+L/(v-u)=2Lv/(v^2-u^2). Yi goes back and forth along OB, and the route is required to remain vertical throughout, so the horizontal component of the swimming velocity must cancel the water flow u, and the remaining vertical effective velocity is sqrt(v^2-u^2). The round-trip distance is 2L, so t乙=2L/sqrt(v^2-u^2). Compare: t甲/t乙 = v/sqrt(v^2-u^2). Since sqrt(v^2-u^2)<v, t甲/t乙>1, that is, t甲>t乙.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出：水流方向箭头向右，O 到 A 是向右的水平虚线段，与水流平行；O 到 B 是向下的竖直虚线段，与水流垂直，且题文给出 OA=OB。设两段长度均为 L，水流速率为 u，两人在静水中游速为 v。甲沿 OA 往返：去 A 顺流，对岸地速度为 v+u；返回 O 逆流，对岸地速度为 v-u，所以 t甲=L/(v+u)+L/(v-u)=2Lv/(v^2-u^2)。乙沿 OB 往返且路线必须保持竖直，需始终让游泳速度的水平分量抵消水流 u，因此其竖直有效速度为 sqrt(v^2-u^2)，往返时间 t乙=2L/sqrt(v^2-u^2)。比较 t甲/t乙=v/sqrt(v^2-u^2)>1，故 t甲>t乙。
